data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'Gol' meaning 'light' and 'Nam' meaning 'name' or 'source'. In Persian, it is associated with the light of the heavens and the source of all creation. The name Golnam carries the meaning “Light of the universe” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Golnam usually hope their child will grow to embody light of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
